description: This header file declares functions and structures for platform-specific filesystem monitoring in a daemon process, including initialization, cleanup, event loop, and asynchronous stop functions.

methods.name: fsm_listen__ctor
methods.description: Initializes platform-specific data for the filesystem monitor listener thread.

methods.name: fsm_listen__dtor
methods.description: Cleans up platform-specific data for the filesystem monitor listener thread.

methods.name: fsm_listen__loop
methods.description: Main body of the platform-specific event loop to watch for filesystem events; runs in the listener thread.

methods.name: fsm_listen__stop_async
methods.description: Requests the listener thread to shut down asynchronously.
